name: EYEDIR
doc: Normalized direction of current pixel. Use this as your basic direction for procedural effects.

name: SCREEN_UV
doc: Screen UV coordinate for current pixel. Used to map a texture to the full screen.

name: SKY_COORDS
doc: Sphere UV. Used to map a panorama texture to the sky.

name: HALF_RES_COLOR
doc: Color value of corresponding pixel from half resolution pass. Uses linear filter.

name: QUARTER_RES_COLOR
doc: Color value of corresponding pixel from quarter resolution pass. Uses linear filter.

name: ALPHA
doc: Output alpha value, can only be used in subpasses.
